rules.title: Mandate
rules.interpretation: Trade a configurable ETF wheel, default SPY. Changing the entry symbol preserves management of existing contracts and shares under their original identity. The investor is willing to own the selected ETF and wants recurrent eligible wheel exposure. Optional event uncertainty is disclosed; the trader obtains contract and premium evidence rather than requiring it from the researcher.

rules.title: Coverage
rules.interpretation: Hold at most one short option. Puts remain fully cash secured including costs, within 90 percent of equity; calls require enough unencumbered deliverable shares. No borrowing, naked options, automatic rolls or disposal of unrelated holdings.

rules.title: Contracts
rules.interpretation: Prefer listed expirations 30 to 45 days away and absolute delta near 0.25. Prefer covered-call strikes at or above verified share acquisition cost. Hold when no suitable contract exists.

rules.title: Management
rules.interpretation: Accept expiry and assignment. Persist a favorable review trigger at 90 percent capture of the actual entry premium after costs, even while it is not met; a weekly review alone does not cover that target. The trigger requests a fresh trader decision about buying to close, not an automatic order. Manage residual orders and exposure before another entry.

rules.title: Attention
rules.interpretation: First setup opportunity is 15 minutes before the session close. With no short wheel option or related working option order, consider an entry once per eligible session near the close, whether cash can secure a put or shares can cover a call. While an option or related working order occupies that capacity, remove obsolete daily setup watches; do not schedule daily setup or research merely because another session opens. Observe cheaply each minute; use meaningful profit, quantity, order, expiry and thesis conditions plus one recurring management review within seven calendar days. Reuse relevant dated research for management; refresh only for an eligible setup or a decision needing fresh evidence. Reconcile assignment, call-away, closing and terminal orders as management first, then preserve the next eligible setup if capacity is free. Clean obsolete watches before saving an updated future review; never delete its newly updated definition.

rules.title: Pricing
rules.interpretation: Use price-bounded limit orders, DAY by default. Smart limits are not the default. Inspect exact option market evidence; disclose historical trade-bar approximation and never replace it with future or current quotes.
